title: Step 8 - recall: the routes from memory
intro: Write step 7's `routes.go` again, from memory. Your
`Bookmark` and `Store` are already in the module.
It needs a type `api` with a field `store *Store`, and
a method `routes() http.Handler` built on a
- `GET /bookmarks`: every bookmark as a JSON list;
the id is not a number, 404 if there is no such one;
Press `<F6>` to submit: `go vet` and the step's hidden
tests decide. If they fail, fix it and submit again.
